period: FY2025 annual report, year ended 31 December 2025

cash_breakdown.item: Cash at bank and in hand
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group-level disclosure does not split parent, Hong Kong and Mainland operating subsidiaries; most business is Mainland restaurants, so usable extraction is haircut to the low end of the group-cash range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 26 discloses cash at bank and in hand within bank balances and cash. It is cash-like, but not all can be treated as immediately distributable control cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank term deposits are cash-like, but RMB669.835 million had original maturity over three months and the group location/withdrawal path is not split.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 26 discloses term deposits with banks inside bank balances and cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Longer-term bank deposits are cash-like but less immediately detachable than short deposits.
cash_breakdown.reason: Consolidated statement of financial position separately discloses non-current term deposits with banks.

cash_breakdown.item: Current FVTPL reverse repurchase treasury bond
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Short PRC government reverse repo maturity of 2 to 28 days supports liquidity, but it is still a FVTPL financial asset rather than bank cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 23 identifies the current FVTPL asset as PRC government reverse repurchase treasury bonds.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Explicitly restricted funds are not detachable.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current asset line item states restricted bank deposits.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Restaurant chain with 617 stores requires liquidity for payroll, materials, rent, tax and store-level volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Estimated at roughly two months of cash operating outflows after considering revenue, cost base, rent payments and working-capital swings.

cash_breakdown.item: Dividend, tax, FX and trapped-cash friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Mainland subsidiaries have large undistributed profits and withholding-tax/cross-border timing uncertainty; reserve is deducted after asset haircuts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 20 discloses undistributed profits of Mainland subsidiaries and dividend withholding-tax considerations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank borrowings are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 30 discloses secured HKD bank borrowings.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Ordinary restaurant lease liabilities are continuing operating commitments and are reflected in profit/cash-flow quality rather than deducted as detachable-cash debt.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 28 discloses lease liabilities, but the leases support the continuing restaurant network.

cash_breakdown.item: Non-current FVTPL unlisted equity and fund investments
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Illiquid unlisted funds/equity have unclear exit path and are not included in the cash-like detachable pool.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 23 classifies them as non-current FVTPL, not held for trading or normal working capital.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Potentially separable non-core assets, but not funds assets; sale timing, tax and pledge constraints are material.
cash_breakdown.reason: Statement of financial position and Note 37 disclose investment properties, including RMB328.412 million pledged.

profit_quality.assessment: The main denominator uses the 2023-2025 attributable-profit median of RMB28.408 million, then applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut. Operating cash flow is strong, but reported profit is volatile, the group carries large lease cash obligations, and earnings include investment-property fair value losses, bank interest income, FVTPL movements, lease termination gains and rental income.
adjustments: Used 2023-2025 attributable profit series of RMB181.188 million, RMB-20.224 million and RMB28.408 million; median is RMB28.408 million.
Did not use the much higher 2023 profit because the series is volatile and 2024 was loss-making.
Did not add back all investment-property fair value losses because a control buyer would still own and manage the investment-property portfolio unless separately disposed.

Checked 2025 operating cash flow of RMB453.149 million against capital expenditure of RMB82.111 million and lease principal repayment of RMB257.678 million; cash support exists but free distributable cash is materially lower after lease payments.
Applied 0.75 profit haircut for restaurant-cycle volatility, lease intensity and mixed investment income/non-cash fair value effects.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 operating cash flow exceeded reported parent profit, and after capex plus lease-principal payments the remaining cash flow was about RMB113.360 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is good in 2025, but three-year profit volatility and lease-heavy restaurant economics justify a 25% haircut rather than treating accounting profit as fully distributable.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Operating cash flow / parent profit equals about 15.95x in 2025, mainly because depreciation, right-of-use asset depreciation and fair-value losses depress accounting profit.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: RMB82.111 million purchase of property, plant, equipment and right-of-use assets is used as maintenance/growth capex proxy; no precise maintenance split was disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working capital movement released cash overall: inventories decreased RMB7.405 million, receivables increased RMB1.904 million, payables increased RMB21.612 million and contract liabilities decreased RMB0.112 million.

limitations: Market capitalization is taken from the run input rather than independently refreshed.
The annual report does not split cash by listed parent, Hong Kong subsidiaries, Mainland subsidiaries and other entities, so cash haircuts are judgmental.
Necessary operating cash and dividend/tax/FX friction reserve are estimated, not company-disclosed line items.
Only 2024 and 2025 detailed cash-flow statements were available in the 2025 annual report text; 2023 cash-flow detail was not re-extracted.

Investment properties and non-current unlisted investments may have value in a control transaction, but they are excluded from detachable funds assets because realization path, tax and pledge constraints are unclear.
